items.title: Sheila Jordan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So my middle name was Jeanette so I went by Jeannie.

ctx.x: It was either George Wallington, or was it Al Haig?

Al Haig, Al Haig. Right, Al Haig. Al Haig was with him once. And then Roy Haynes was with… and I met Roy Haynes. He was very sweet. And we became good friends, Roy and I. He dressed so sharp, you know, and he liked the way I dressed. He said, “Oh, you dress so sharp.” I said, “I‟m trying to keep up with you.” But by this time, I think we were like eighteen, nineteen, twenty. But in Detroit, you couldn‟t get in the bars until you were twenty-one. And of course, I got to be twenty-one there and of course I hung out…
couple of other places. What was that place on 12th Avenue, Cameron? Years… oh, before your time. Brown, C.: Clan‟s [?] Show Bar.
